caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bucket with a single curved handle attached to the top by two rounded fastenings. The body of the bucket consists of vertical wooden slats bound together by two wide horizontal bands, one near the top edge and one near the base, as well as a narrower band just above the bottom. The wood texture is visible, with the coloring of the bucket mainly in shades of blue with areas where the paint appears worn, revealing a brownish wood tone underneath. The handle and bands have a brown hue, and the entire bucket is shaded to show form and depth. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a handwritten signature below the bucket to the left.
title: Wooden Bucket
